```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY ent_ext 'External Entity Value'>">
  %ent;
  <!ENTITY ref "&ent_ext;">
  <?pi-target data="value"?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub">
  <!-- Top level comment exercising comment paths -->
  <?pi-target2 processing-instruction-data?>
  <sub:child id="1">
    <![CDATA[ CDATA block with <tags> & references inside &ref; ]]>
  </sub:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ELEMENT description (#PCDATA)>">
  %param;
  <!ENTITY sample "Sample Text & More">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://xml.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment before PI and CDATA -->
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="style.xsl"?>
  <item xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      <!-- Nested comment-like syntax inside CDATA -->
      Some raw text with entities: &sample;
    ]]>
  </item>
</catalog>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record)*>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base-ent "Base Entity">
  <!ENTITY comp-ent "&base-ent; and Compound">
  <?db-control action="init"?>
]>
<database xmlns="http://xml.database/ns" xmlns:db="http://xml.database/db">
  <!-- Header comment for database -->
  <?db-log level="debug"?>
  <db:record id="rec1">
    <![CDATA[
      First CDATA section containing entity reference &comp-ent;
    ]]>
  </db:record>
  <db:record id="rec2">
    <![CDATA[
      Second CDATA section with special characters: <>&'"
    ]]>
  </db:record>
</database>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ext-macro "<!ENTITY macro-ref 'Macro Content'>">
  %ext-macro;
  <!ENTITY final-ref "&macro-ref; Extended">
  <?system-cmd exec="nop"?>
]>
<doc xmlns="http://xml.org/doc" xmlns:prefix="http://xml.org/prefix">
  <!-- Comment wrapping around namespace and processing instructions -->
  <?prefix-pi processing="true"?>
  <prefix:section>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section holding XML markup <section> &final-ref;
    ]]>
  </prefix:section>
</doc>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (file)*>
  <!ELEMENT file (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY data-ent "Archive Data">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY readme SYSTEM "readme.txt" NDATA txt>
  <?archive-param mode="secure"?>
]>
<archive xmlns="http://xml.archive/ns" xmlns:arc="http://xml.archive/arc">
  <!-- Comment explaining archive structure and entities -->
  <?arc-info version="1.0"?>
  <arc:file name="main">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with entity: &data-ent; and arbitrary symbols <> &
    ]]>
  </arc:file>
</archive>
